subject.title: [Feature]: Agent Runtime: Configurable stopReason="length" catch-and-continue for mode:"run" sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a configurable per-agent length-truncation policy for mode:"run" sessions, and should the first supported behavior be hard-fail only or bounded catch-and-continue?
rationale: The remaining work adds a new runtime policy and config/default surface after current main already fixed the accidental partial-tool-call execution subset, so automation cannot choose the permanent user-facing semantics.

options.title: Hard-fail first
options.body: Add or document a narrow fail/signal behavior for length-truncated mode:"run" sessions before introducing automatic continuation.

options.title: Design bounded continue
options.body: Add catch-and-continue only with a max-continuation budget plus explicit replay, terminal-output, and side-effect rules.

options.title: Keep generic incomplete-turn handling
options.body: Close this as not planned if maintainers decide the current incomplete-turn error path is the only supported runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Hard-fail first
recommendation.body: Add or document a narrow fail/signal behavior for length-truncated mode:"run" sessions before introducing automatic continuation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent provenance for the merged truncation-safety fixes that this policy would build on.
